Capabilities

What UEDEV builds for Unreal teams — from navigation and AI down through the effects layer.

01

Volumetric 3D Navigation

LCM 3D Navigation AI — sparse voxel octree pathfinding with GPU voxelization, Mass crowds and true-3D tactical queries for flying and swimming agents.

02

Game AI

Behaviour trees, detour steering and decision systems that stay smooth as agent counts climb.

03

Gameplay Systems

Combat, physics and runtime ECS architectures written in C++ for shipping-grade performance.

04

Real-time VFX

Production-grade Niagara effects — explosions, beams, shields and environments — profiled to hold frame budget.

05

Engine Tooling

Editor plugins and pipeline tools that take the repetitive work out of your team's day.
